messages:
maria-sales: heads up 10AM call with HelioMed went well. They're ready to sign the POC but procurement sent conditions: they want invoicing split (US entity + EU entity), net-60 on the POC, and a 7.5% holdback until go-live. Also pushed a DPA tweak: 'processed in EU only' and asked for KMS/HSM custody proof.

tara-legal: thanks. two quick Qs: do they require separate legal entities on the MSA or just on the invoice? if it's invoice-only we can keep a single MSA and add an invoicing appendix. regarding the DPA "EU-only" ask, propose counter: "EU processing for EU customer data, with standard cross-border subprocessors if needed". HSM proof: we can provide our KMS integration diagram + attestation; we don't ship HSM hardware to customers.

kevin-finance: net-60 is doable with credit approval. prefer single invoice with an internal allocation code rather than two invoices - reduces billing ops churn. if they insist on two invoices, we'll need EU VAT ID and billing contact and may need to register VAT handling. can sales confirm estimated amount?

leo-solutions: Tech note: KMS options:
- cloud-kms (fast): integrate in 2-3 business days, attestation available
- customer-managed keys in their cloud project: need IAM alignment, 5-7 days
- physical HSM on-prem: adds 3-4 weeks + on-site coordinate
If they just want proof of custody, we can produce a 1-page attestation + key rotation policy.

maria-sales: they indicated approx $36k for the 2-month POC. I'll push back on two invoices and offer single invoice with breakout lines per entity. Also confirm holdback percent is negotiable (they asked 7.5% but might accept 5%).

upload-bot: invoice_split_template.xlsx uploaded to /files/HelioMed/invoice_split_template.xlsx :link:

kevin-finance: if it's $36k and single invoice we can accept net-60 after a credit check. holdback: recommend we move to a holdback appendix with a release timeline (e.g., release within 21 days of go-live verification). that avoids invoice adjustments.

tara-legal: I'll prepare two items: 1) short invoicing appendix language for single-MSA with invoicing entities noted (informational), and 2) holdback appendix that enumerates acceptance tests and release terms. ETA: EOD today.

leo-solutions: I'll write acceptance test examples to include in the appendix: smoke endpoint tests, a minimal accuracy check against provided dataset, and a latency SLO (p95 < 300ms). Happy to sync with Legal to make the language measurable.

maria-sales: perfect. asks for next steps:
- Tara: upload the two appendix redlines (ETA EOD)
- Kevin: run credit check & confirm net-60 path (ETA tomorrow morning)
- Leo: post acceptance test bullets (ETA 2 hours)
I'll also ask HelioMed if they'd accept single invoice w/ cost allocation lines and confirm whether EU entity can issue a PO for its portion.

tara-legal: noted. if customer can issue an EU PO for their 40% share that cleans up VAT. otherwise proceed with single invoice + invoicing appendix + VAT note.

kevin-finance: will start credit check now. if customer fails credit, we'll need either prepay or exec approval.

maria-sales: thanks all. tagging @tara-legal & @kevin-finance when the docs go up. I'll keep the customer informed and try to narrow holdback to 5%. :crossed_fingers:
